purpose: Round G: the per-criterion proof level and the pin successors, every test driving bin/rcf.js against a fixture project (e2e): test strength, the Test verdict, Finalise and separation per level (AC-19905-1 to -9, -12), the writer and the enum refusal (AC-19905-10, -11), and the probe shapes at the pin at rcf-schemas 0.11.0 (AC-19905-13 to -15, and the own chain at that pin, AC-19905-16)
title: US-19905 criteria (round G, the per-criterion proof level)

testCases.description: a chain with no proof on any criterion gives rcf audit test-strength --record the 0.40.1 output byte for byte: the same stdout line, the same exit code and the same record bytes, every field but wallMs and node compared, in the golden test-strength-proof-absent-0-40-1.json
